mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, organizer_id, start_time, end_time, location, max_participants, status, created_at, updated_at FROM activities WHERE status = 'published' AND end_time > NOW() ORDER BY start_time ASC

SELECT DISTINCT ap.activity_id FROM activity_participants ap INNER JOIN activities a ON ap.activity_id = a.id WHERE ap.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'published' AND a.end_time > NOW() ORDER BY ap.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.organizer_id, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.location, a.max_participants, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(ap.attended, 0) as attended FROM activities a INNER JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id WHERE ap.user_id = #{userId} AND (a.status = 'finished' OR a.end_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY a.end_time DESC
SELECT id, title, description, organizer_id, start_time, end_time, location, max_participants, status, created_at, updated_at FROM activities WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE activities SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, location = #{location}, max_participants = #{maxParticipants}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_participants (activity_id, user_id, attended) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{userId}, 0)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_participants WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
